predicate.name: toolQuestionEcho
design_properties_verified: source-type-based: applies ONLY to opencode:<session>:tool:<tool> native source anchors (regex ^opencode:[^:\s,]+:tool:[^:\s,]+)
query-content-based: normalized full current question must appear inside the normalized fact (lowercase, non-letter/digit runs collapsed to single spaces, trimmed)
query length guard: normalized question requires >= 24 characters AND >= 5 words, so short prompts are never treated as full echoes
exclusion-only: the predicate can reject a candidate, it cannot admit a previously ineligible fact
no hardcoded case name, source ref, target UUID, commit SHA or benchmark expected answer in the predicate
application_points: rankedCandidates shared admission loop (final relevanceFilter selector AND rankQualifiedForMerge reranker path, cached or live)
predicate.invariants_preserved: no context-excerpt reveal; source/group/safeText fences, 24-candidate bound, one-fact output, serial MCP, bounded optional remote membership proof, temporal scope and 300ms native allowance all unchanged

s10_contaminant_inspection.verdict: CONFIRMED_TOOL_ORIGIN_FULL_QUESTION_ECHO (no EVIDENCE_CONFLICT): the suspect record is a tool-origin persisted record whose fact embeds the full frozen S10 question; the independently sourced expected commit-subject record is a genuine non-echo tool observation. Raw private text and original records remain on host only.
